The '''2022 Retro League Event 1''' was the first event of the [[2022 Retro League]] on [[GEMP]] (11 February – 30 March 2022), played in [[Premiere - A New Hope]] format. 33 players registered, and [[Paul Todd Feldman]] won.<ref name="t80194" /><ref name="t80048" />

== Format ==
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - A New Hope]]
* '''Site:''' [[GEMP]]
* '''Dates:''' 11 February – 30 March 2022
* '''Structure:''' six games of Swiss, one game a week, scored by strength of schedule; 45-minute timers per side<ref name="t80048" /><ref name="t80194" />
* '''Players:''' 33
* '''Winner:''' [[Paul Todd Feldman]]
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Steve Sanders]]<ref name="t80296" />

== Final standings ==
